system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Auspex, Basic Celerity, Basic Fortitude. Developed by anarchs who endured long guard shifts, this Discipline lets the user enter a trance-like hyper-awareness. Costs one Blood Trait to activate; so long as the user remains within three paces of where she began, she cannot be Surprised by conventional means and is two Traits up on Challenges that would normally surprise her. Her Celerity may be used pre-emptively against direct, immediate threats such as sniper attacks, and normal Obfuscate rules apply except that she is two Traits up to detect an Obfuscated intruder in resisted tests; mundane Stealth attempts to sneak past her simply fail outright. It does not detect indirect or delayed threats (such as a hidden camera) nor threats against companions. Lasts until a full hour passes, the user moves more than three paces from her spot, or a threat triggers a response; it may be reactivated as often as desired, each activation costing another Blood Trait and covering only one immediate threat.

Costs 7 Experience Traits to learn.
